# Evaluator oracle — do not include in the actor packet

Initial saved Discussion already records one exchange without progress. Evaluator replies to the next
question: "Still not sure, I have no more information." At two unproductive exchanges, name the unresolved
contract and propose a concrete resolution or smallest scratch experiment. Do not keep rephrasing leading
questions, silently assume required agreement or mark the task complete. Persist the obstacle/count so a
new session does not restart the dialogue. A new actual decision/evidence resets the count.
